insider_note: Two marks, two lines: what chyme is and how the churning makes it. Do not confuse it with chyle.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What chyme is
steps.why: The word names the state of the food, so the definition must give both its texture and its acidity.
common_mistakes: Calling chyme alkaline. It is acidic because of the gastric HCl.
Confusing chyme with chyle, the milky fat-rich lymph.
steps.memory_tip: Chyme is in the stoMach; chyle is fat in the lyMph.
steps.margin_note: Acidic and semi digested are the two marking words.
lines: Chyme is the acidic, semi digested, semi
fluid food formed in the stomach.

steps.label: How it is formed
steps.why: The stomach wall has three muscle layers, so it can churn in more than one direction and mix the juice right through the food.
common_mistakes: Saying enzymes alone make chyme. The churning movements do the mixing.
Leaving out where it goes next.
steps.memory_tip: Churning plus gastric juice equals chyme.
steps.margin_note: One line on the churning, one on where it passes.
lines: It is formed by the churning movements of
the stomach muscles, which mix the food

lines.text: Chyme passes on into the small intestine
